concept.title: Paddle shifter
concept.shortdesc: The paddle shift function is available when the vehicle is in D (Drive) or manual shift mode.

section.title: With the gear in D (Drive)
section.p: The paddle shift function operates when your speed is above 10 km/h (6 mph).
Pull the (+) or (-) paddle shifter once to shift up or down 1 gear. The system changes from automatic mode to manual shift mode..
To change from manual shift mode back to automatic shift mode, perform one of the following actions:

li.p: Pull the (+) paddle shifter for more than 1 second.
Shift from D (Drive) to manual mode, and then return to D (Drive).

section.p: Manual shift mode also changes back to automatic shift mode in any of following situations:

li.p: You gently engage the accelerator pedal for more than 6 seconds while driving (Not available in manual shift mode.)

note.p: If you pull both paddle shifters at the same time, you cannot shift the gear.

section.title: With the shift lever in manual mode
section.p: Pull the (+) or (-) paddle shifter once to shift up or down 1 gear.
